access_requirements.partner_program_name: HubSpot App Partner Program (only for Marketplace listing)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Not required to install on customer accounts via OAuth install URL; Marketplace listing requires certification (error rate under 5% of daily traffic per docs).
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Super Admin installs the app from our install link and approves scopes. Alternative: customer creates a Private App / service key with read scopes and shares the token.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Immediate for unlisted OAuth app; Marketplace review UNVERIFIED

sandbox.how_to_get: Free developer test accounts from the HubSpot developer account (self-serve)

rate_limits: Public OAuth apps: 110 requests per 10 seconds per installing account; private apps 100/190 per 10s and 250,000-1,000,000 per day by tier; Search API does not return rate-limit headers
incremental_sync: CRM Search API filtering hs_lastmodifieddate GTE cursor, paged by 'after'; webhooks for deltas
blockers: Search API result cap and per-account 110/10s limit make large backfills slow.
sources: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/oauth-quickstart-guide - 'The access token will expire ... currently 30 minutes'; 'Super Admin access to install apps'
https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/usage-details - 'Each HubSpot account that installs your app is limited to 110 requests every 10 seconds.'
